answer: A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, which means paying the juniper bond on all of them and exposing each to the vertex slash. Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 4 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. Because the crystal audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. A farm of 37 pays that 193 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
